Forced Operation Mode (Compressor / Defrost Test): Press & hold "Energy Saver" + "Fridge" (or "Power Freeze" + "Fridge") for 8 seconds until beep.
records.procedure:
1. Hold both buttons simultaneously.
2. Display will flash and beep, then show illuminated LED segments indicating specific error codes.
records.tests:

records.exit: Press "Energy Saver" + "Fridge" again or automatic exit after 30 minutes.
records.notes: Error segments on the "88" display map directly to sensors: Top-left vertical segment = Ice maker sensor, Bottom-right = Defrost sensor, Middle bar = Ambient sensor.

records.exit: Press SW1 to cycle to 4th press (Reset) or unplug power for 10 seconds.
records.notes: In Test 1, measure voltage on 3-phase compressor connector (UVW) or test linear compressor stroke; in Test 3, check amp draw on blue defrost wire.

4 clicks Right (Rinse LED lit) -> Press START -> Calibration Mode (Recalibrates basket optical sensor and weight detection, runs 2-4 mins empty).

If GLOWS THEN CLICKS OFF WITHOUT FLAME: Gas valve coils failed. Test coil resistance: 2-terminal coil = 1200-1400 Ohms; 3-terminal coil = pins 1-2 (1300 Ohms), pins 1-3 (550 Ohms). Often coils fail when heated up.
records.fix: Replace igniter or replace gas valve coil set (split coil + main coil).

records.entry: Drifted or open/shorted RTD temperature sensor probe, or stuck relay on control board.
records.procedure: Remove 2 screws inside oven holding sensor probe. Disconnect harness clip. Measure resistance at room temp (70°F / 21°C): MUST BE 1080 - 1100 Ohms. At 350°F (177°C): ~1650 Ohms. If reading is <1000 or >1200 at room temp, or OL, sensor is bad.
records.fix: Replace RTD temperature sensor probe. If sensor is good, perform temperature offset calibration (±35°F) or replace main ERC control board.

records.topic: Gas Oven bake element won't light
records.entry: Weak glow bar igniter (lost electrical draw), failed safety valve, or open thermal fuse.
records.procedure: Connect clamp meter around one of the igniter wires. Turn Bake ON. Read amperage: Normal operation: Igniter draws 3.2 to 3.6 Amps. At 3.2A, bi-metal gas safety valve opens and gas ignites. Defect: If igniter glows orange/yellow but draws ONLY 2.5 - 3.0 Amps, gas valve will NEVER open.
records.fix: Replace flat/round glow bar igniter (Norton / Robertshaw style).
